title: Yayoi Kusama, Japanese Pop Artist Known for Polka-Dot Paintings, Dies at 97
summary_full: The Japanese artist’s polka-dot-covered paintings, phallic sculptures and public performances caused a stir in New York City and Europe in the 1960s.
